claim: Schema, GameData identity, invalid/unknown/duplicate spell ids and missing coverage all fail closed with a stable code; rows freeze in canonical spell order.
evidence: Probe asserts UnsupportedSchema, WrongGameDataIdentity, InvalidSpell(0), UnknownSpell, DuplicateSpell, MissingSpell. Core test crates/data/tests/spell_external_policy.rs covers the same.

boundary: Absent is never inferred from missing coverage
claim: An empty or partial catalog is rejected at construction; an absent catalog (builder without external_spell_policy) or a missing row makes both evaluators return "not immutable", so admission fails.
evidence: Empty spells -> MissingSpell (probe). Complete Martial package without a catalog rejects with InvalidOwnerFact "complete absent external proc, script, lifetime, cost, and stack policy". The only all-Absent synthesizer is test-support absent_spell_external_policy (tools/test-support/src/lib.rs:142-182), a dev-dependency of every runtime crate (no [dependencies] edge).

claim: A complete catalog bound to a different GameDataIdentity is ignored (treated as absent) by both evaluators, so it can never satisfy owner policy.
evidence: Probe builds a catalog for game_build+1 and passes it to the builder; the complete Martial package is rejected. Note: builder.build() does not reject the mismatched catalog up front (it only compares data vs actions identity), so a program with no selected owners silently accepts it; harmless because no consumer trusts it.

boundary: Present and Unknown fail closed in every column
claim: Each of the nine presence columns set to Present or Unknown on the owner rejects selected admission; only all-Absent passes.
evidence: Probe loops 9 columns x {Present, Unknown} = 18 rejections for the complete Martial Expert package (the raw-108 sibling compiler runs the policy).

boundary: One authoritative executable policy boundary (selected roles)
claim: Every selected-role final compiler calls selected_trait_owner_policy_issue before admission.
evidence: Eight role compilers call it; the raw-638 CriticalBlockAmount compiler does not. A complete one-effect selected raw-638 package compiles with no catalog, with Present proc/script, with Unknown columns, with a Magic-dispel owner, and with proc-charged AuraOptions (independent reproduction of CSA-A-02). Live gate: only 429638:2 carries raw 638 and its raw-108 sibling compiler runs the policy.

boundary: Duplicate evaluators of the all-Absent predicate
claim: The two all-Absent evaluators (selected owner policy and the raw-416 inert-domain check) agree on identity filtering, columns and Absent-only acceptance.
evidence: Both filter catalog.identity()==data.identity(), read the same nine accessors, and require == Absent; the 416 check additionally requires Passive and all ownership roles PassiveModifier. Class B/C duplication, no divergent outcome found.

boundary: Candidates cannot become executable without final validation
claim: Engine trait candidates only produce ResolvedActionCatalogInput rows and EngineInput bindings; the only path to an executable program is CombatProgram::builder(...).build(), which runs the final compilers.
evidence: No production Engine code builds a CombatProgram (engine test_support.rs is #[cfg(test)]); candidates never read external policy (grep), so the boundary is the final compiler — subject to EP-K-005 (raw 638) and EP-K-011 (ordinary Passive route).

boundary: No runtime world lookup / no retained policy
claim: The policy catalog is only borrowed during build; CombatProgram, CombatState and Engine retain no reference or copy, so no runtime path can consult world policy.
evidence: CombatProgram and CombatState are lifetime-free structs; SpellExternalPolicyCatalog appears only in program/* compile-time signatures (grep of crates/combat/src/state*, crates/engine/src finds no use).

claim: A production generator projects Absent/Present/Unknown from the complete world overlay (spell_proc, spell_script_names, cooldown/cost/cast/interrupt/empower/stack sources).
evidence: No generator exists in core, wowlab-data, core-sidecar or wowlab (grep for effective_proc_entry / SpellPolicyCatalogInput). Core cannot distinguish a projected catalog from a fabricated all-Absent one; the trust boundary is entirely the host. See UNK-K-002.

boundary: Raw attribute 416 exception bound to external policy
claim: Disabled raw 416 is skipped only for Passive owners whose every role is PassiveModifier and whose identity-matched policy is all-Absent; elsewhere it rejects.
evidence: Global audit rejects Disabled otherwise (spell_attribute.rs:68-75). Selected owner policy tolerates 416 only after the all-Absent check (selected_trait_package.rs:443-461 precede 513-517). The raw-638 private owner-attribute check rejects 416 (CSA-A-03, track A).

boundary: Ordinary Passive activation route for trait-provider rows
claim: proc/script/world policy has one authoritative executable boundary for immutable passive owners.
evidence: Ordinary Passive raw-290 (Canny Strikes 1250359) and raw-638 (Martial Expert 429638:2 alone) compile and bind with no trait source, no external policy and (for 638) no package sibling. Heart raw-334 ordinary Passive is rejected.

boundary: Trigger-spell inertness premise on selected shells
claim: A selected effect trigger spell is accepted as inert only where effective proc policy is proved Absent.
evidence: selected_effect_shell_is_supported treats EffectTriggerSpell as inert for 11 subtypes; for every role except raw 638 the owner policy then proves effective_proc_entry Absent. The raw-638 path passes trigger_is_inert=true for SelectedTrait without any policy: a triggered single raw-638 package compiles with a Present effective-proc policy.
